title: Create the private broker directory before spawning its daemon
hypothesis: A fresh cache causes spawn node ENOENT because the client chooses a nonexistent socket parent as the daemon working directory; validating and creating that directory before spawn removes the first-use failure without relaxing the private-path boundary.
measurement: No model calls or desktop writes. The new regression fails with ENOENT on baseline 9bb7bf6. Candidate: component typecheck passes; broker socket/packaged tests 12 pass; compiler/pretest controls 5 pass; product archive/distribution tests 40 pass. Actual clean-installed .7 archive successfully starts a daemon with a missing directory and completes handshake and lease acquire/release with 0700/0600 modes. Full suite exceeded 300 seconds and is not reported as passed.
result: Reuse ensurePrivateDir before spawn; reject symlinked directories before starting a child. Component 0.5.1-rotom.7, locked archive and integrity pins carry the fix. All 8 native files remain byte-identical to .6. No active helper replacement, product installation or npm publication; effect on subsequent real sessions remains unmeasured.
